requirement: The electronic purse shall allow only card issuer personnel holding the administrator role to change the spending limit stored on a card, and shall deny every other user the ability to view that limit.
The data warehousing system shall permit only users assigned the data steward role to edit dimension table definitions, and shall deny read access to those definitions to all users lacking that role.
The compiler shall detect source files crafted to trigger buffer overflows in its parser, reject them, and terminate compilation without executing any embedded content.
The online banking application shall block any client session that submits more than ten malformed requests within one minute while continuing to serve all other sessions normally.
The electronic purse shall enter a locked state that refuses all transactions when it detects voltage or clock manipulation intended to induce faults in the card chip.

The online banking application shall detect automated credential-stuffing traffic, block the offending source addresses, and send an alert to the security administrator each time such traffic is detected.

The sales forecasting system shall reject repeated submissions of crafted input designed to exhaust its model-training service and shall inform the system administrator whenever such a submission is blocked.
The database server must detect SQL injection attempts, refuse the offending statements, and send a notification to the database administrator for every blocked attempt.
The electronic purse shall accept a payment request only from a terminal that proves its identity with a valid certificate issued by the scheme operator.
The web browser shall verify that a synchronisation service presents a valid certificate matching its claimed domain name before establishing a synchronisation session with it.
The electronic purse shall require the cardholder to enter the correct PIN before it authorises any payment.
The smart-home IoT controller must require each person using the mobile app to present a registered account name and its matching credential before it accepts any device command.
The compiler's cloud build service shall allow only users who present a valid, registered identity token to submit compilation jobs.
The screen capture tool shall require each user to prove their identity with a registered account before it uploads any recording to the shared team library.
The simulation software must verify the identity of each operator against the organisation's directory before granting the operator the ability to launch a simulation run.
The data warehousing system shall load each record so that the stored values match exactly the values in the source extract, and shall flag any record whose checksum differs after loading.
The online booking system shall store every reservation with the same dates, times and guest details that the customer submitted at confirmation.
The compiler shall guarantee that constant values written in the source code appear unchanged in the generated binary.
The air traffic control software shall encrypt flight plans exchanged with ground stations and shall block and report any attempt to intercept or replay messages on those links.
The database server shall encrypt customer records at rest and shall block any connection that attempts to extract bulk data through repeated abnormal queries.

The data warehousing system shall refrain from sending personal data to external reporting services without the data subject's consent and shall detect and block exfiltration attempts made through compromised accounts.
The online booking system shall reject any reservation request whose check-out date precedes its check-in date or whose guest count is not a positive whole number.
The hospital patient-record system shall refuse entry of a blood-pressure reading outside the physiologically possible range and shall require the clinician to correct the value.
The compiler shall validate that every build configuration option holds a value of its declared type within its permitted range and shall abort the build when any option fails this check.
The online booking system shall reject a second simultaneous sign-in by the same travel agent from a different device and shall display a warning on both devices.
The data warehousing system shall lock an analyst account for 15 minutes after five consecutive failed sign-in attempts.
The sales forecasting system shall block any client that submits more than 100 forecast requests per minute and shall return a rejection message to that client.

domain: payroll and human resources management system
requirement: The payroll system shall let users without payroll-administrator rights view salary records but shall prevent them from creating, editing or deleting any record.
The data warehousing system must grant guest analysts view-only access to fact tables and must block every insert, update and delete operation they attempt.
The electronic purse shall let a terminal lacking issuer rights read the card balance but shall refuse any command from that terminal that would change the stored balance.
The compiler's web-based IDE shall terminate a session after 15 minutes without user input so that an unattended workstation cannot be exploited by an intruder.
The smart-home IoT controller shall close the administrative interface session after ten minutes without interaction and shall require a new session to be started before further changes.

domain: payroll and human resources management system
requirement: The payroll and human resources management system shall end an employee's session after 10 minutes without activity to prevent misuse of an abandoned browser.
